scope: Batch D paper-expanded commercial expert knowledge staging runtime

business_ownership.critical_journey: Runner asks training, injury-risk, fueling, heat, recovery, or strength question; system retrieves governed expert evidence and keeps medical/nutrition/rehab content within allowed-use boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: gold QA passes without red-flag regression
medical/rehab/nutrition/environment sources cannot write core prescriptions
license-limited papers do not copy publisher abstract or full text

architecture_and_interfaces.data_flow: source candidates -> license audit -> review selection -> AI review reports -> reviewed sources -> expert evidence -> commercial staging chunks -> staging runtime manifest -> readiness reports
architecture_and_interfaces.api_contract_impact: No public API contract change in this batch; artifacts are governance/runtime data files.
architecture_and_interfaces.compatibility: Default and v2 runtime directories are not replaced by Batch D staging runtime.
architecture_and_interfaces.idempotency: Artifact builders are deterministic for the same JSONL inputs and overwrite only the named Batch D output files.
failure_modes: missing two AI reviewer passes blocks staging eligibility
red_flag review keeps source as candidate
manifest can_replace_runtime=true would block release readiness
gold QA red-flag failure blocks readiness

tencent_cloud_access_and_network_safety.secrets_or_long_lived_keys: none introduced by this artifact batch
required_before_deploy: assign least-privilege runtime artifact reader role
keep environment-specific paths and credentials out of source files
define gateway or service access policy before exposing any runtime endpoint

privacy_controls_present: no user PII added to Batch D artifacts
paper full text and publisher abstracts are not copied
human_reviewed remains false without human artifact
required_before_production: redact runner PII and health details from logs
define retention period for queries and evidence traces
protect exported governance artifacts and runtime manifests

reliability_and_scale.current_runtime_status: staging runtime built successfully with 13 chunks
reliability_and_scale.rollback_path: continue using existing default/v2 runtime; do not route production traffic to Batch D staging runtime until release owner approves
reliability_and_scale.capacity_assumption: small staging evidence set; no production throughput claim
required_before_production: runtime health check for manifest load and FAISS/chunks availability
feature flag or config switch for staging runtime routing
rollback command or deployment procedure documented
startup failure should fail closed to existing stable runtime

missing_runtime_signals: latency and error rate by QA mode

logs: structured governance decision logs with PII redaction

alert_requirements_before_production: owner and severity for citation failure spikes
owner and severity for medical referral boundary failures
runbook for fallback to stable runtime

controls_present: candidate sources require review before staging eligibility
medical/rehab/nutrition sources cannot write core prescriptions
runtime replacement is blocked by manifest
compliance_claims_blocked: medical device or medical diagnosis capability
required_before_production: audit trail for release approval and rollback
human expert review artifact for any medical-adjacent release claim

launch_blockers.description: No real human expert approval artifact exists; cannot claim human_expert_reviewed or medical release readiness.
Manifest correctly keeps can_replace_runtime=false; production traffic must not switch to Batch D staging runtime.
Medical, rehab, heat, and nutrition content remains guidance/risk-gate only and cannot be marketed as diagnosis or treatment.
Runtime metrics, traces, alerts, and runbooks are not yet implemented for production operations.
Production release and rollback ownership must be assigned before any launch.

residual_risks: AI reviewer pass is not a substitute for human domain expert review.
Paper license audit is conservative but not legal counsel.
Gold QA covers boundary checks but not full user-query distribution.
Staging runtime is small and not a production capacity proof.
